exposure: Robson classification (10 groups based on parity, previous cesarean delivery, number of fetuses, fetal presentation, gestational week, and onset of labor)
infant size for gestational age ≥ 50(th) percentiles
Nulliparous women with singleton, cephalic, term pregnancies
cohort: 2,137 pregnant women aged ≥ 18 years seeking prenatal care at two tertiary Thai hospitals
finding: Cesarean delivery rates were elevated in specific Robson groups, suggesting tailored interventions are needed to minimize non-clinically indicated cesarean deliveries.
